I’ve used these doctors for over a year. I will say that it took a while to get registered with them and once I was they wouldn’t give me any prescriptions without reviewing them with me. This was tricky for me as I had ran out of my meds and had been told by the pharmacy that they couldn’t give me any more emergency medication and my doctors at that time was 4 hours and an expensive train ride away. So firstly, I would advise anybody thinking of switching to Roathwell to be snappy about it and try to acquire as much meds as you can from your current doctor. But my doctors knew I was moving and couldn’t give me the three months worth of meds that I think Roathwell advised. Not everybody has a mum who by sheer will gets meds to them.

On the topic of my mother. Once she came down to see me and tried to help me with the above problem. The receptionist there was rude to my mother. However, this is because my mum was talking on my behalf as I had asked her to and often did with these kinds of things due to my anxiety. I haven’t seen that receptionist in a while, she can be very nice but she also can come across as very rude.

Sometimes I’ve had to repeat myself and assert myself (something I’m not good at), for Roathwell not to make me call for appointments. Because if I had to do that (which I can’t due to travelling and being at work during that time), I would just suffer in silence. I really think the whole on the day appointments that doctors are really pushing everybody to do is a ridiculous and awful system. Not everybody is able to talk on the phone and they may not have others who would do this for them. Plus for some people like me on the day appointments are an absolute nightmare and I’d rather wait a month (if I can).

Now onto the good stuff. At my old doctors sometimes I was dismissed and the problems I was facing were treated as nothing. Every doctor I have seen here has listened and responded with empathy and understanding. For their support and for really seeing me, I am eternally grateful.

The receptionist’s here have also been very helpful and kind to my partner and I. Occasionally they have gone above and beyond, but other times they have come across as dismissive.

I think many issues this surgery is facing is not any fault of theirs. Doctors are overstretched, underfunded and overworked. The NHS is struggling so much, it isn’t just the aftermath of COVID. Though it has made things a lot worse, the NHS was struggling
